Amedica Corporation originally developed medical-grade silicon nitride ceramic spinal fusion products. In 2018, it sold its commercial spine business to CTL Medical (which renamed itself [CTL Amedica](https://ctlamedica.com/)), and Amedica later rebranded as SINTX Technologies. The historical spine brand names and primary manufacturing partners associated with the transition include: [](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_349cca3b0f00f53781e69438d5ca1466/sintx/news/2015-01-20_InterMed_Resources_and_Amedica_Corporation_31.pdf)

- **Valeo:** Silicon nitride interbody fusion devices.

- **Taurus:** Spinal fixation and pedicle screw systems.

- **Preference:** VBR and cervical/lumbar spacer solutions.

### Manufacturer Partners & Corporate Successors

- **CTL Amedica:** Acquired the commercial spine product lines and distributes them globally while utilizing ongoing OEM supply. [](https://www.todaysmedicaldevelopments.com/news/ctl-amedica-spine-medical-91418/)

- **Kyocera Industrial Ceramics Corporation:** Long-term manufacturing collaboration partner used for commercial production of advanced medical-grade silicon nitride ceramic components. [](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_349cca3b0f00f53781e69438d5ca1466/sintx/news/2015-01-20_InterMed_Resources_and_Amedica_Corporation_31.pdf)

- **SINTX Technologies:** The corporate evolution of Amedica, functioning as a research and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) for silicon nitride applications outside of retail spine sales.
